video_method: Real ffconcat frame durations, millisecond input timebase, VFR H264 at 960px width. Each actual frame is held until the next actual timestamp; last real image held until recording stop. No interpolation.
audio_method: Actual WAV encoded AAC. Piecewise PCM sample-clock timestamp offsets preserve inferred listener replacement gap; no apad/aresample/async, generated PCM or missing-audio synthesis. AAC packet/block rounding and player gap handling remain limitations.
packet_timing_caveat: MP4 represents AAC gaps by extended packet duration until the next packet timestamp. Decoder/player gap behavior can differ; original WAV and callback-clock evidence are authoritative. No gap-filling PCM filter was used.
synchronization_status: DEGRADED: listener-only mux does not locate internal PCM loss; later audio can lead images by cumulative loss until a later listener boundary
